name: Gunnar Guðjónsson
body: dear Paul Bedrosian  i have a hard time accepting this. our friendship as cousins started about 35 years ago which was so beautiful i didn't speak english and you didn't speak icelandic but still an unbreakable friendship and memories were formed. the kids thought you were so much fun and always looked forward to when you were coming. i was so happy when you called and told you you were going to be a dad now i will make sure to be there for ólaf in the future until we meet again dear cousin rest in peace ❤️
